title: Helvesec/rmux
claim: Helvesec/rmux — Universal Rust multiplexer with a typed SDK — drive any CLI or TUI app from code. Native on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
why_good: The ability to drive any CLI or TUI app programmatically opens up opportunities for automation and integration in diverse environments.
value: Companies in DevOps and system administration could pay for premium features or support, generating revenue through subscriptions or licensing.
risk: The project could struggle to gain traction if larger incumbents integrate similar functionality into their existing tools.
